APPROVE
`Read` drops to a cognitive complexity of about 1 and its logic moves unchanged into small `Reader` methods. The nested class can still reach the private static helpers, so it should build. One assumption is unverified because the file isn't on this machine: the top-level check now calls `IsDependencySection(_top)` instead of the inline `"dependencies" or "devDependencies" or "optionalDependencies"` pattern, and that is only equivalent if `IsDependencySection` (its body is cut off in the diff) matches exactly those three names.
